mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbox_events (id, event_type, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, payload_json, status, attempts, next_attempt_at, last_error, created_at, published_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{eventType}, #{aggregateType}, #{aggregateId}, #{payloadJson}, #{status}, #{attempts}, #{nextAttemptAt}, #{lastError}, #{createdAt}, #{publishedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM outbox_events WHERE status = #{status}
